summary: refactor(shared): move fxa-shared db models, setup and RedisShared to legacy db lib
description:
Because:

- The db models, db setup and RedisShared lived in fxa-shared, which is moving to Nx libs.

This commit:

- Moves fxa-shared db/{index,redis}.ts and db/models to @fxa/shared/db/mysql/legacy.
- Repoints every auth-server, admin-server and fxa-shared test importer 1:1.
- Embeds the RedisShared Lua scripts in lua-scripts.ts and adds redis.spec.ts.
- Removes the moved fxa-shared db exports and adds ip and @types/ioredis to root.
- Fixes the TTL mock sequence in the moved domain-blocklist spec.

Closes FXA-14705
